subject: Save objects besides MSImagingExperiment to file

messages.author: 510f43c000020d39
messages.subject: Save objects besides MSImagingExperiment to file
parts:
What is the recommended way to save objects of class SpatialShrunkenCentroids, SegmentationTest, etc. to file?

For example, objects of class MSImagingExperiment can be saved to disk via readMSIData() and writeMSIData(), but those functions do not always work with objects of other classes.

Since oftentimes the underlying data is memory-mapped on-disk as a matter matrix, does would saveRDS() work in this case?

messages.author: 6033d3c0e7d242fa
messages.subject: Re: Save objects besides MSImagingExperiment to file
parts: Currently, the result objects from statistical analyses are entirely in-memory as R objects, so saveRDS() should work.
